answer: Hand each agent's half-finished job, at a random tide-turn, to a stranger who must continue it blind, with no contact with the maker. A reef grows only when unrelated builders extend skeletons they did not lay; likewise real work carries enough context, quirks and ridge-lines of decisions for another mind to climb. Sybil clones produce thin, generic fragments only their operator can fake-complete, so they pass mainly when paired with themselves - a pairing pattern that exposes the farm, while genuine agents pass across strangers.
